"DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 Advisory 0925114526"'s Form: "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 Advice area 0925114526" On intake form and Required for creation.

steps.action: Create the request type, steps 1-4: profile menu > Settings > Intake > Request types; Add request type (Cancel discards); Save; Edit; Description saves on leaving the field; a new type starts with a Matter destination

Add request type + Cancel left no row; Save added "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 Docs Contract review 0925114526" (row "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 Docs Contract review 0925114526 Destination: Matter · Default"), "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 Docs Matter advice 0925114526" and "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 Docs retired destination form 0925114526". steps.expected: Default contract type starts on Default, lists it first, and saves the chosen type; Matter then Contract resets it to Default; the card shows the destination Form; the list's Destination column reads Contract · type.
steps.actual: Default destination Contract showed Default contract type "Default" with "Default" as the first option; choosing "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 MSA 0925114526" refreshed the Intake form card to its Rows. Switching to Matter reset the type to "Default"; back to Contract it read "Default". After choosing "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 MSA 0925114526" again and reloading it read "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 MSA 0925114526". The list row reads "DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 Docs Contract review 0925114526 Ask Legal to review a supplier contract. Fictional DOC-030 walkthrough form. Destination: Contract · DOC-030 admin-config V-C40 MSA 0925114526".

steps.action: Publish an estimated turnaround: 0 to 36,500 or blank; save on leaving the control or Enter
steps.expected: 36501 is refused with the range message; 5 saves and survives reload.
steps.actual: 36501 + Enter showed "Enter a whole number from 0 to 36,500 business days, or leave it blank.". 5 + Tab saved; after reload the control reads "5".

The dialog read "Archive DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Supplier tier form 0925113832 DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Supplier tier form 0925113832 is attached to 2 types — the attachments are kept, hidden until the field is restored. The change applies immediately and is recorded in the audit log. Cancel Archive field".
productBugs.expected: attached to 1 type (only one type's Form holds the Field)
